title: Functor of the strict-tower completed pullback
statement: For a scheme morphism g:X→Y and Noetherian adic datum d, define completedPullbackFunctor as completedReductionTower Y d followed by completedTowerPullback g d followed by completedTowerRlim d X. Its object at K is exactly the published completedPullbackObject g d K; its map is the functorial map of this specified composite. This records the existing functor and auxiliary normalized finite constructions separately from their completed-pullback reduction theorem. It also packages the native reduction-tower and exact pullback cochain counits as natural transformations, and composes supplied cochain comparisons by whiskering and composition, retaining their specified component maps. The finite and pulled model maps are also packaged as natural transformations; the two normalization predicates are the same component equations instantiated from generic normalized-descent predicates.
